title: Difference equations of average entropies
summary: Exact cumulants of entanglement entropies of random state ensembles have traditionally been studied within the random matrix framework. In this work, we propose an alternative approach based on the intrinsic connection to integrable systems. The central idea is to embed entropic quantities into tau functions satisfying Toda-type lattice equations, which in turn yield linear difference equations for their averages.
